root_idea.summary: The root denotes a grave or sepulchre; its Quranic plural أَجْدَاث refers to graves.
root_idea.development: The lexical evidence shows a concrete burial-place noun, جَدَثٌ, with the plural أَجْدَاث; the derived Form VIII اِجْتَدَثَ expresses making or preparing a grave.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic plural أَجْدَاث is presented under the normalized singular dictionary citation form جَدَث.

senses.usage_conditions: The Quran attests the plural أَجْدَاث, used for graves in resurrection scenes. Classical evidence also records أَجْدُث as a plural and notes dialectal variation in the corresponding form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or prepare a grave or sepulchre, whether for oneself or another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII derived verb; the construction may express preparing a grave for the agent himself.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The derived Form VIII action of making or preparing a grave is represented as a Classical meaning.
The noun's grave or sepulchre meaning is represented under the Quran-attested form.

cautions: The public headword is normalized to the singular جَدَث, while all three Quranic occurrences are the plural أَجْدَاث.
